items.answer: SkillTwin is a Competency Intelligence Platform that helps assess competencies, identify skill gaps, recommend learning, support training, measure improvement and support certification.
SkillTwin identifies the difference between current competency levels and the competencies required for a role, program or learning objective.
SkillTwin uses assessments to understand current competency levels and produce measurable competency information.
SkillTwin can use identified competency gaps to guide personalized learning paths, courses and relevant resources.
SkillTwin supports competency certification and certificate history as part of the competency-development lifecycle.
Trainers can manage trainees, courses, learning resources and assessments while monitoring competency and progress.
Institutions can use SkillTwin to manage learners and trainers, programs, assessments and competency analytics.
Industry and organizations can use SkillTwin for workforce competency mapping, role-based requirements, skill-gap analysis, training requirements and workforce analytics.
SkillTwin pricing is currently being developed and may depend on organization size, users, modules, analytics and integrations.
